title: MTN Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship Scheme
description: Annual scholarship providing ₦300,000 yearly tuition and living stipend to high-performing Nigerian university students in Science, Technology, and Health disciplines in Nigerian public universities (including UNIBEN).
eligibility: Nigerian undergraduate students in 200L or 100L with strong CGPA (or top UTME/WAEC performance for entry level).

title: NNPC / Chevron Joint Venture National University Scholarship
description: Prestige scholarship covering full tuition, book allowances, and maintenance for Nigerian university undergraduates studying Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Engineering, and Science at accredited Nigerian universities.
eligibility: 100-Level admitted students with min 5 O'Level credits and high UTME scores in Nigerian universities.

title: Seplat Energy PEARLs JV Undergraduate Scholarship Scheme
description: Dedicated scholarship program specifically targeting host and operational states including Edo State and Delta State. Provides ₦200,000 - ₦300,000 annually for undergraduates in Medical Sciences, Engineering, and Humanities.
location: Edo State & Delta State Priority / National
eligibility: Registered 100-Level undergraduates in federal/state universities in Nigeria, with strong focus on Edo/Delta residents.

title: Agbami Medical & Engineering Professionals Scholarship Scheme
organizer: Star Deep Water Petroleum Limited (A Chevron Company) & FAMFA Oil
description: Specialized national scholarship strictly dedicated to students studying Medicine, Surgery, Nursing, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Science, and Engineering in Nigerian universities.
eligibility: 100-Level Nigerian undergraduates in recognized medical / healthcare programs.

title: Edo State Government Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
organizer: Edo State Ministry of Education / Edo State Scholarship Board
description: State-sponsored bursary and merit awards for indigenes and residents of Edo State admitted into tertiary institutions, with special allowances for healthcare disciplines at UNIBEN.
eligibility: Edo State indigenes/residents admitted into tertiary institutions.

title: Federal Government of Nigeria Bilateral Education & Tertiary Scholarship
organizer: Federal Ministry of Education (Federal Scholarship Board - FSB)
description: National bursary and Nigerian undergraduate award covering university tuition and book allowances across Nigerian federal universities.
eligibility: Nigerian students with minimum CGPA / admission in federal universities.

title: Nigeria Health Watch Annual Health Journalism & Essay Challenge
description: Youth essay and advocacy writing competition focused on practical solutions to primary healthcare, maternal health, and epidemic preparedness in Nigeria.

title: United Bank for Africa (UBA) Foundation National Essay Competition
description: Prestige national essay competition awarding millions of Naira in university educational grants and laptops to top winning Nigerian secondary school / pre-university writers.
eligibility: Senior secondary school students and recent school leavers in Nigeria.

title: Young African Leaders Initiative (YALI) Regional Leadership Center West Africa
description: Intensive leadership, public management, and civic leadership program empowering young Africans with civic and health project execution skills.
eligibility: Young Africans (18-35) demonstrating leadership and community track record.

title: Tony Elumelu Foundation (TEF) Entrepreneurship Programme
description: Pan-African entrepreneurship initiative providing business training, world-class mentorship, and $5,000 non-refundable seed capital to innovative young entrepreneurs (including fashion/tailoring and healthcare startups).
eligibility: African entrepreneurs aged 18+ with a viable business idea or early-stage business (0-3 years).
